origin.headline: An obsession with cars brought us together.
origin.paragraph1: Alexis and Flavio met through the same thing that's driven both of them for decades — an obsession with cars, racing, and the pursuit of perfection down to the smallest detail. It's a world where nothing is left to chance: every line, every tolerance, every component considered on purpose.
origin.pullQuote: After years running separate businesses, that shared standard was reason enough to build something together.
origin.paragraph2: GT Development is what happens when that obsession leaves the garage. The same discipline that goes into perfecting a car — precision, craftsmanship, zero tolerance for shortcuts — is what we bring to every home we design and build.

capital.headline: Equity, debt, and founder capital — arm's-length, every time.

rows.label: Construction Debt — GT Private Lending & Similar Lenders

capital.note: Where GT Private Lending finances a GT Development project, it does so on the same rate, leverage, and underwriting terms it would extend to any third-party borrower — disclosed to GT Private Lending's capital partners as a related-party transaction. Same tolerance, no exceptions.

whoWeAre.headline: A developer that underwrites like a lender.
whoWeAre.paragraph1: GT Development sits inside GT Group alongside GT Private Lending and GT Home Lending — which means every lot we take on has already been stress-tested against real construction costs, real comps, and a real exit, before an offer is ever made.
whoWeAre.paragraph2: Every project is a single-purpose entity, built by a lean, contracted team rather than a fixed overhead one — architects, GCs, and trades brought in per project, engineered to fit the site and the buyer it's built for.

items.question: What makes GT Development different from a typical spec builder?
items.answer: Every site is underwritten the way a private lender underwrites a loan — real construction costs, real comps, real exit pricing — before we ever make an offer, not after.

items.question: Which markets do you build in?
items.answer: Miami-Dade and Palm Beach counties, targeting single-family lots that support a $3M–$10M finished sale price.

items.question: How is a project financed?
items.answer: A mix of investor equity, construction debt from GT Private Lending or comparable lenders on arm's-length terms, and founder capital in first-loss position.

items.question: Can I invest in a specific project?
items.answer: Yes — capital comes in deal-by-deal into a single-purpose project LLC rather than a blind-pool fund, so you see the underwriting on the specific site before committing.

items.question: Is GT Development related to GT Private Lending?
items.answer: Both are part of GT Group. When GT Private Lending finances a GT Development project, it's on the same terms it would offer any outside borrower, disclosed as a related-party transaction.
